mainEntity.name: Can thick bonding damage my natural teeth?

acceptedAnswer.text: While the bonding material itself doesn't typically damage natural teeth, excessively thick bonding can alter bite forces and create areas prone to plaque accumulation, which may indirectly contribute to tooth decay or gum problems if proper oral hygiene isn't maintained.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to fix thick bonding?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required depends on the extent of the problem. Simple recontouring and polishing can often be completed in a single appointment lasting 30-60 minutes, whilst complete replacement of thick bonding may require 1-2 hours per tooth.

mainEntity.name: Will insurance cover correction of thick bonding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insurance coverage varies depending on your policy and the reason for the correction. If the thick bonding is causing functional problems or was the result of improper initial treatment, some coverage may be available. Purely cosmetic corrections are typically not covered.

mainEntity.name: Can I prevent my bonding from becoming too thick?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing an experienced practitioner, communicating your expectations clearly, and understanding the limitations of bonding treatment helps ensure appropriate thickness. Discussing the planned approach before treatment allows you to address any concerns.

mainEntity.name: Does thick bonding always need to be replaced completely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Minor thickness issues can often be addressed through careful recontouring and polishing. Complete replacement is typically reserved for cases where the bonding is significantly thick or where other problems exist with the original bonding.

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my bonding thickness is normal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Normal bonding should feel comfortable when biting and speaking, appear natural in size and shape, and allow for easy cleaning with regular oral hygiene techniques. If you experience persistent discomfort or notice significant changes in appearance, professional evaluation can help determine if the thickness is appropriate.
